description: A synthetic-only flagged occurrence has zero weight, so the canonical competing reading remains c.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text (w ≻ missing) | c | d
%rule(leftmost-longest) w X [+T] | [+U] X
%rule missing M N
%rule(leftmost-longest) c X T
%rule(leftmost-longest) d X empty
%rule(leftmost-longest) empty T
